completionSentence: UI를 닫아도 실행은 계속되고, sleep·재부팅 뒤에는 중단 사실과 정확한 상태를 복원해 안전하게 재개한다.
qualified: One private token-fenced runtime owns one canonical state while UI clients attach zero to many.
Closing UI and native bootstrap does not stop runtime; explicit full stop drains active Work as interrupted_resumable and releases PID, port and owner.
Update and uninstall refuse replacement when exact runtime drain fails; successor reopens the same canonical state without force kill.
A wall-clock sleep gap never claims execution and reopens queued Work and Automation publication reconciliation.
Crash or reboot without a clean stop is recorded as interrupted with no execution claimed during downtime.
macOS LaunchAgent and Windows Startup bootstrap the common headless attach entry once at login without owning product meaning in core.
Automation notifications use fixed generic copy with zero content, file name, counterparty, amount or secret fields.
Telegram polling, Automation occurrence and result delivery retain their existing exact owner and non-replay controls.
notClaimed: Execution while the computer is asleep or powered off
Signed or notarized macOS package qualification for this source
Physical Windows install, update, rollback or login-start qualification
